# add the knit block
# add load data and packages
# standardize dates and build a unique profile identifier
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

abiotic_all <- abiotic_all %>%
  mutate(
    field_date = as.Date(field_date),
    sample_year = as.integer(sample_year),
    month = month(field_date),
    month_label = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb),
    profile_uid = paste(sample_year, profile_index, sep = "_")
  )

nutrients_all <- nutrients_all %>%
  mutate(
    field_date = as.Date(field_date),
    sample_year = as.integer(sample_year),
    month = month(field_date),
    month_label = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb),
    profile_uid = paste(sample_year, profile_index, sep = "_")
  )
```

# Sampling effort by site and year
```{r}

sampling_effort <- abiotic_all %>%
  group_by(station_name, sample_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_profiles = n_distinct(profile_uid),
    n_months = n_distinct(month),
    n_depth_records = n(),
    median_depths_per_profile =
      n() / n_distinct(profile_uid),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Visualize the number of distinct profiles
```{r}

ggplot(
  sampling_effort,
  aes(
    x = factor(sample_year),
    y = fct_rev(station_name),
    fill = n_profiles
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "mako",
    name = "Profiles"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Ecology monitoring effort, 2019–2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Monitoring station"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# descriptive statistics
```{r}

summarize_variables <- function(data, variables) {

  data %>%
    select(all_of(variables)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = "variable",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_valid = sum(is.finite(value)),
      n_missing = sum(!is.finite(value)),
      pct_missing = round(
        100 * n_missing / n_total, 2
      ),
      min = if (any(is.finite(value)))
        min(value[is.finite(value)]) else NA_real_,
      q25 = if (any(is.finite(value)))
        quantile(value[is.finite(value)], 0.25) else NA_real_,
      median = if (any(is.finite(value)))
        median(value[is.finite(value)]) else NA_real_,
      mean = if (any(is.finite(value)))
        mean(value[is.finite(value)]) else NA_real_,
      q75 = if (any(is.finite(value)))
        quantile(value[is.finite(value)], 0.75) else NA_real_,
      max = if (any(is.finite(value)))
        max(value[is.finite(value)]) else NA_real_,
      sd = if (sum(is.finite(value)) > 1)
        sd(value[is.finite(value)]) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

abiotic_vars <- c(
  "temperature",
  "salinity",
  "dissolved_oxygen"
)

nutrient_vars <- c(
  "nitrate",
  "nitrite",
  "ammonium",
  "phosphate",
  "silicate"
)

abiotic_stats <- summarize_variables(
  abiotic_all, abiotic_vars
)

nutrient_stats <- summarize_variables(
  nutrients_all, nutrient_vars
)
```

# histograms
```{r}

plot_histograms <- function(data, variables, title) {

  data %>%
    select(all_of(variables)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = "variable",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(value)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 40,
      fill = "#0072B2",
      color = "white"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ variable,
      scales = "free",
      ncol = 2
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Measurement value (see variable units)",
      y = "Observation count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_histograms(
  abiotic_all,
  abiotic_vars,
  "Abiotic measurement distributions"
)

plot_histograms(
  nutrients_all,
  nutrient_vars,
  "Nutrient measurement distributions"
)
```

# comapring seasonal patterns
```{r}

profile_summary <- abiotic_all %>%
  group_by(
    station_name,
    sample_year,
    month,
    profile_uid
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    field_date = first(field_date),

    mean_temp = mean(
      temperature, na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_salinity = mean(
      salinity, na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_do = mean(
      dissolved_oxygen, na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    min_do = if (all(is.na(dissolved_oxygen)))
      NA_real_
    else
      min(dissolved_oxygen, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_depths = n_distinct(depth_m),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(mean_temp, mean_salinity, mean_do),
      ~ replace(.x, is.nan(.x), NA_real_)
    )
  )

```

# temperature across months
```{r}

ggplot(
  profile_summary,
  aes(
    x = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.abb),
    y = mean_temp
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "#56B4E9",
    outlier.alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly temperature distributions",
    subtitle = "Profile means, 0–13 m",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# binning by depth
```{r}

abiotic_binned <- abiotic_all %>%
  mutate(
    depth_bin = cut(
      depth_m,
      breaks = c(0, 2, 5, 9, 13),
      labels = c(
        "0–2 m",
        "2–5 m",
        "5–9 m",
        "9–13 m"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = TRUE
    )
  )
```

# Summarize measurements within each profile and depth bin
```{r}

profile_depth_summary <- abiotic_binned %>%
  filter(!is.na(depth_bin)) %>%
  group_by(
    station_name,
    sample_year,
    month,
    profile_uid,
    depth_bin
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_temp = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_salinity = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_do = mean(dissolved_oxygen, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_depths = n_distinct(depth_m),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(mean_temp, mean_salinity, mean_do),
      ~ replace(.x, is.nan(.x), NA_real_)
    )
  )

```

# month x depth bin heatmap
```{r}

monthly_depth <- profile_depth_summary %>%
  group_by(month, depth_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    median_temp = median(mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_profiles = sum(!is.na(mean_temp)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_temp = if_else(
      is.nan(median_temp),
      NA_real_,
      median_temp
    )
  )

ggplot(
  monthly_depth,
  aes(
    x = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.abb),
    y = depth_bin,
    fill = median_temp
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "°C"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal temperature by depth stratum",
    subtitle = "Median of profile-bin means, 2019–2025",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Depth bin"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# nutrient steps
```{r}

ggplot(
  nutrients_all,
  aes(x = depth_m)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    fill = "#009E73",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_year) +
  labs(
    title = "Nutrient sampling depths by year",
    x = "Sample depth (m)",
    y = "Number of records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

profile_coverage <- abiotic_all %>%
  group_by(profile_uid, station_name) %>%
  summarise(
    shallowest_depth = min(depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
    deepest_depth = max(depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_depths = n_distinct(depth_m),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reaches_10m = deepest_depth >= 10,
    reaches_12m = deepest_depth >= 12
  )

```
